entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="さあ、かかってこい！" t="Let the festivities begin!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="さあ、かかってこい！" t="Să înceapă distracția!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ふん、無駄な努力を" t="I do not know why they even try." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ふん、無駄な努力を" t="Nici nu știu de ce se mai chinuie." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Careful, grenade!
Oh, I missed this!
Not much longer now!
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="ゴミの多い街だ！" t="Fucking Night City!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ゴミの多い街だ！" t="Naiba de Night City!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="後悔しても遅いぞ！" t="You made a big mistake!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="後悔しても遅いぞ！" t="Ai greșit amarnic!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: This will buy us some time!
entries.ro: Asta ne va cumpăra ceva timp!

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="アラサカ様万歳！" t="For Arasaka-sama!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="アラサカ様万歳！" t="Pentru Arasaka-sama!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="くっ… 息が… できん…" t="I... can't... breathe..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="くっ… 息が… できん…" t="Nu... pot... respira..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: I can wait. It is not me who is dying.
entries.ro: Pot să aștept. Nu eu mor aici.

entries.en: Do you have what they call "ADD?"
Ready to give your full attention?
entries.ro: Ești gata să-ți dai toată atenția?

entries.en: Shall we continue?
There is no time to waste, V.
entries.ro: Nu e timp de pierdut, V.

entries.en: V?
V.
It is good you are here.
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="ちゃんと前を見て歩け！" t="Like a blind man without canes!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ちゃんと前を見て歩け！" t="Ca un orb fără baston!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Argh, V! Control your movements!
Are you still there?
Let us be quick.
The time for doubts has passed.
Get out. Let's not waste time.
You aim to be found? Let's move.
entries.ro: Vrei să fii găsit? Hai să mișcăm.

entries.en: Sharpen your mind.
I have eagerly awaited this!
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="流れに身を任せよう！" t="Feel the momentum!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="流れに身を任せよう！" t="Simte elanul!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="すぐに終わらせてやる！" t="This will be quick!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="すぐに終わらせてやる！" t="Termin repede!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: It had been too long.
I have nothing more to add.
entries.ro: Nu mai am nimic de adăugat.

entries.en: Ahh… How hungry I was.
Do not charge recklessly!
This ends poorly if you black out!
Retreat! Gather your strength!
V! I cannot manage alone!
I require backup!
Help! V!
Reloading!
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="弾切れだ！" t="Clip's empty…" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="弾切れだ！" t="S-a golit încărcătorul…" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="リロードしなければ" t="Need to reload." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="リロードしなければ" t="Trebuie să reîncarc." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="手榴弾だ！" t="Grenade!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="手榴弾だ！" t="Granată!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Incoming! Grenade!
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="受け取れ！" t="This is for you!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="受け取れ！" t="Na, ia!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="とくと味わえ！" t="You'll enjoy this!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="とくと味わえ！" t="O să-ți placă asta!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ざまあみろ！" t="One less!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ざまあみろ！" t="Unul mai puțin!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="もらった！" t="I have you!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="もらった！" t="Te-am prins!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="手加減無用だ！" t="I hope that didn't hurt!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="手加減無用だ！" t="Sper că nu te-a durut!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Stay alert – we may be in sniper crosshairs!
entries.ro: Fiți cu ochii în patru – poate suntem în vizorul unui sniper!

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="頭出すな！ 狙撃手だ！" t="Heads down! Sniper!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="頭出すな！ 狙撃手だ！" t="Capul jos! Sniper!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Enemy turret!
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="タレットに気をつけろ！" t="Watch out for the turret!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="タレットに気をつけろ！" t="Atenție la turelă!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Careful, active netrunner!
Hostile netrunner alert to you!
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="ドローンは好かん！" t="I despise drones!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ドローンは好かん！" t="Detest dronele!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="空飛ぶゴミめ" t="Flying vermin!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="空飛ぶゴミめ" t="Jeguri zburătoare!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="気をつけろ、オクタントだ！" t="Look out, an Octant!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="気をつけろ、オクタントだ！" t="Atenție, un Octant!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: This does not bode well!
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="ブリキを相手にせざるを得ないとは！" t="I prefer a fight human on human!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ブリキを相手にせざるを得ないとは！" t="Mai bine ne luptăm om cu om!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Do you see what I see?!
Now comes the real test!
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="面倒な奴が現れた" t="We have a problem." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="面倒な奴が現れた" t="Avem o problemă." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: And who is this wretch?!
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="何だ、あれは…？" t="What the hell…!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="何だ、あれは…？" t="Ce dracu'…!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Now! We have the advantage!
They are reloading! We attack now!
Yes? Moving then?
Well, let's go.
Biochip got your brain? Let's move.
entries.ro: Biochipul ți-a luat creierul? Hai să ne mișcăm.

entries.en: This is not a good time to ponder life.
Quickly, V.
Keep a low profile this time, yes?
entries.ro: Ține-te discret de data asta, da?

entries.en: Much better. But remember we do not want attention.
entries.ro: Mai bine. Dar ține minte, nu vrem atenție.

entries.en: There.
We are not alone.
I see someone.
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="気づかれたか…？" t="Did they notice…?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="気づかれたか…？" t="Ne-au observat…?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Be careful!
Did they notice us?
Their security is comprehensive. Think before you step.
entries.ro: Securitatea lor e cuprinzătoare. Gândește-te înainte să faci un pas.

entries.en: You must be vigilant in this area.
entries.ro: Trebuie să fii vigilantă în zona asta.
entries.ro_m: Trebuie să fii vigilent în zona asta.

entries.en: You plan to leave them exposed?
It is in plain sight…
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="さあ来い！" t="Come on!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="さあ来い！" t="Hai!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Hahaha!
Quietly…!
Exercise caution.
